samples.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is the only way to drop an href there, but the underlying `removeLink()` is caret-only and silently no-ops for the natural "select the linked text, click Remove link" gesture
samples.evidence: `TextFormatGroup` now renders an always-enabled Remove-link button for Slides (`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:176`, opted in at `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx:93` and `mobile-toolbar.tsx:580`). It forwards to `SlidesTextBoxEditor.removeLink` (`packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650`) → docs `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` (`packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248`), which resolves the link purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt` (`packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:33-58`) and returns early when the caret is not inside/at the edge of a linked run. In docs this was safe because Remove link is only offered from the link popover, which appears only when the caret is in a link; the Slides button has no such gate (the diff's own comment at text-format-group.tsx:167-172 says it is deliberately never gated). A user who drag-selects text that extends past the link (focus lands in a non-link run) gets a silent no-op, and since #1051 Clear formatting no longer removes links, there is no fallback path in Slides. Fix belongs either on `removeLink` (use the selection range when one exists) or on the new button's enablement/feedback.

samples.summary: The third Clear-formatting entry point (docs text-box / Slides) got the shared constant change but not the trailing-edge link-exit guard the other two got — currently benign only because it no-ops at a collapsed caret
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1077-1082` calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)`, and `applyStyleImpl` (`:819-821`) returns immediately without a selection, so there is no pending-style path and no href re-arm — unlike `editor.ts:3344` and `text-editor.ts:3426`, which both needed `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }`. If the text-box editor ever grows a collapsed-caret pending path (as `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl` at `:870-887` already has), it will silently inherit the link-extension bug the other two entry points now guard against. Worth a comment or a shared helper rather than three hand-copied conditions.

verdict.reason: Verified the full chain in-repo. The Remove-link button is rendered always-enabled (text-format-group.tsx:310-325, gated only on `isDisabled` at :186, with the deliberate no-gate comment at :167-173) and is opted into by Slides desktop (text-edit-section.tsx:93) and mobile (mobile-toolbar.tsx:580). It forwards through SlidesTextBoxEditor.removeLink (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650-652) to docs TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248), which resolves the link solely from `cursor.position` via findLinkRunAt and returns early at :1238 — no selection branch, unlike insertLink at :1188-1191. findLinkRunAt (link-run.ts:33-58) only matches offsets inside/at the edge of an href-bearing inline, so an offset past the link end yields undefined (:50). Reachability is concrete: the caret tracks the selection focus for every pointer gesture (text-editor.ts:2056-2057 triple-click to paragraph end, :2068-2069 double-click, :2074-2075 shift+click, via setSnappedRange :2394-2399), and expandRangeForLinks only snaps endpoints strictly interior to a link (link-run.ts:207-233 with interiorLinkRunAt :155-159), so a selection containing the link plus trailing text leaves the caret outside the link and Remove link silently does nothing. Slides has no fallback: onLinkRequest is unwired (slides-view.tsx:738-750) and clear-formatting deliberately preserves hrefs (text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts:126-130, editor-clear-formatting.test.ts:219-231). Selecting the link exactly does work (edge-inclusive), so the headline is a little broad, but the stated failing case is real, reachable, and user-visible. In-lane: a new consumer of an unchanged cross-package symbol whose caret-only precondition it does not satisfy, with the broken behaviour outside the diff.

finding.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is wired to a caret-only `removeLink()`, so it silently no-ops when the user selects the linked text (the natural gesture) and the caret/focus lands outside the link run
finding.evidence: `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` reads only `cursor.position` and bails when `findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset)` is undefined (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248); the selection range is never consulted. The new toolbar handler calls it unconditionally (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:173-178, `removeLink()` is a no-op off a link, so an over-eager click costs nothing). In a text box whose content is e.g. "see example now" with the link on "example", Cmd+A / drag-select and click Remove link leaves the caret at the end of "now" → findLinkRunAt returns undefined → nothing happens, with no feedback. Since `onLinkRequest` is unwired in slides (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:736-750) this button is the *only* link-removal path there, and Clear formatting no longer removes links, so the user is left with no working way to unlink unless they happen to park the caret inside the run. The fix belongs on `removeLink` (prefer the selection range / all link runs it covers when a selection exists) or on the new handler.

verdict.reason: All claimed facts check out in the repo. `removeLink` at packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248 reads only `cursor.position` and returns when `findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset)` is undefined; `selection.range` is never consulted (contrast `insertLink` at :1188 and `applyStyleImpl` at :819-831, which do branch on `selection.hasSelection()`). The new always-enabled toolbar button calls it unconditionally (text-format-group.tsx:174-178, rendered :310-325) on the stated assumption that it is a harmless no-op off a link. The caret really does leave the run on a broad selection: the text box drives the shared TextEditor (text-box-editor.ts:669) whose selectAll moves the cursor to the end of the last block (text-editor.ts:3395-3413, bound at :1056/:1174), and findLinkRunAt only matches an inline containing or edging the offset (link-run.ts:33-58). No fallback exists in slides: onLinkRequest is not supplied to initializeEditor (slides-view.tsx:710-751), the docs popover unlink path is docs-only (docs-link-popover.tsx:154), and clearInlineFormatting deliberately preserves href (text-box-editor.ts:263-271, 1077-1082). The slides wrapper is a bare delegation (slides/.../text-box-editor.ts:650-652), so no guard or selection normalisation intervenes. This is a new consumer relying on an existing exported symbol's narrower caret-only contract, in the blast-radius lane, and the failure mode (silent no-op with no other unlink path) is major.
